title: 火锅分几派②潮汕牛肉火锅：一头牛，涮火锅的不到三成 | China Hotpot Schools P2 · Chaoshan 🐮
description:
同一头牛，你敢猜能涮火锅的有多少？评论区留个数。

【火锅分几派·第2集 潮汕牛肉火锅】一头牛，真正适合涮火锅的部位不到三成。潮汕师傅却能把它切成十几个部位——脖仁、吊龙、吊龙伴、匙仁、匙柄、胸口朥、三花趾、五花趾……每一块肥瘦纹理都不一样，连涮的时间都不同：吊龙嫩，六到八秒就得夹起来；胸口朥厚，要涮足五分钟。行规是当天现宰、绝不隔夜。锅底走清汤，只放牛骨和白萝卜，蘸一口沙茶酱——潮汕话喊一声「正！」这一派不靠辣，靠一个字：鲜。

Of a whole cow, less than 30% is good enough for the pot — yet Chaoshan masters carve it into a dozen named cuts: neck, sirloin (diao long), spoon-shank, chest fat and more. Each has its own fat and grain, and its own timing: tender sirloin comes out in 6–8 seconds, while thick chest fat needs a full five minutes. The rule is same-day slaughter, never frozen. The broth stays clear — just beef bone and white radish — and you dip in sacha sauce. No chili here. One word: fresh.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
